'''Lirisa Casti''' was a hotshot [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]]. Formerly a [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] pilot for [[Lant Mining Corporation]], Casti was fired and eventually joined the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. She owned the [[Ghtroc Industries/Legends|Ghtroc Industries]] [[720 light freighter/Legends|Class 720 freighter]] ''[[Star Trader]]''.
